learning_outcomes.text: To acquire the introductory knowledge of the engineering use of physical laws for the construction and design of power machines and equipment.
Students will obtain the knowledge energy sources in the technical practice, their ecological, economic and energetic aspects.

syllabus_topics: Using the energy of the sun
Use of wind energy and biomass
Application of the first law of thermodynamics for a closed system.
Application of the first law of thermodynamics for open system.
Calculation of properties of gaseous mixtures.
Calculation of isobaric, isochoric and isothermal state changes.
Calculation of adiabatic reversible and irreversible state changes.

assessment_methods.method: delivery of a project for the given topic
oral examination (discussion about a given topic)

assessment_rules: Graded credit requirements include active participation in exercises and timely submission of a project. The examination has a written part with questions and examples, and an oral part as a discussion on a given topic. Participation in exercises is systematically controlled.
institution: WYSOKÉ UCENI TECHNICKÉ V BRNE - Brno University of Technology
